transcript: Speaker A: English mein ing ke ye rules agar aapne seekh liye, toh fir kabhi spelling mein mistake nahi karoge. Jump ke peeche ing lagaye toh jumping ho jata hai, par run word ke peeche agar hum ing lagaye toh running, yaani yahan ek ki jagah double n ho jata hai. [If you learn these rules for adding 'ing' in English, you will never make spelling mistakes. Adding 'ing' to 'jump' makes 'jumping', but adding it to 'run' makes 'running' with a double 'n'.] Kabhi socha hai aisa kyun? Chalo iska ek simple rule main aaj aapko samjha raha hoon. [Ever wondered why? Let me explain a simple rule today.] Jo bhi word hai, usme hamesha peeche se letter count karo, ek, do. Agar do number par koi vowel yaani a, e, i, o, u aaya aur uski short sound nikal kar aa rahi hai, toh rule yaad rakho: one, two, double, I do. Yaani aakhri letter ko double karke ing laga do. [Count letters from the end of the word. If a vowel is at the second position with a short sound, double the last letter before adding 'ing'.] Isiliye run ka ho jayega running, aur tap ka bana tapping. [That's why 'run' becomes 'running' and 'tap' becomes 'tapping'.] Lekin agar hum jump ko peeche se count karein, one, two, three, yahan vowel teesre number par aa raha hai. Toh iska rule hai: one, two, three, it's not for me. Yaani yahan double nahi karna hai, seedha ing lagana hai. [But in 'jump', the vowel is at the third position from the end. So, just add 'ing' without doubling.] Isiliye jump ka bana jumping, aur help ka bana helping. [So 'jump' becomes 'jumping' and 'help' becomes 'helping'.] Lekin English ke aise hi hazaaron shortcuts, dimaag khol dene wale rules, aur daily use hone wali English ab bina rate English Seekho app se seekh sakte ho. [You can learn thousands of such shortcuts and daily English without memorizing on the English Seekho app.] Yahan par aapko koi boring padhai nahi karni hai. Aap experts ke aise hi short, crisp, aur smart videos dekhkar rozana bolne wali English, mushkil grammar rules, aur ekdum perfect pronunciation yaani har word ko sahi se bolne ki smart tricks seekh sakte ho. [No boring studies here. Learn daily English, grammar, and pronunciation through short, smart videos by experts.] Aur sabse mazedaar features, app mein ek AI coach hai jiske saath aap bina kisi hichkichahat, sharm, ya mazak ke darr ke din-raat English bolne ki practice kar sakte ho. [The best feature is the AI coach, allowing you to practice speaking English day and night without hesitation or fear of judgment.] Woh aapki har galti ko pakad ke turant sahi karega, aur aapki English ko ekdum mast aur polish kar dega. [It will correct your mistakes instantly and polish your English.] Toh ab rule ka ratta maarna band karo, smart tareeqe se video se seekho, aur AI coach ke saath farratedar English bolna shuru karo. Abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Stop memorizing rules, learn smartly from videos, and speak fluent English with the AI coach. Download the English Seekho app now.]
